title: Ten and Oh, and the Power Ratings Still Have Peyton Fifth
dek: Peyton beats John to reach 10–0, Chris & Miguel come back from 19% against Nathan, and Mack and Michael combine for the 5th highest-scoring game in league history.

sections.head: The lead
body: Peyton is 10–0. The Loose Stools handled John 110.8–73.0, which is the best start in Brown Cow since Mack opened 14–0 in 2024, and the 10-game win streak is now 5 away from Mack's record of 15. Peyton also leads the all-time series with John 9–8–1, for anyone keeping a grudge ledger.

And yet. The power ratings have Peyton at **+1.5**, fifth in the league, behind a 3–7 Dustin. The luck table has Peyton scoring like a 7.3-win team, +2.7 wins of good fortune, the most in the league. Ten wins count the same whether you earned them or not, but the model would like everyone to know it noticed.

sections.head: Comeback of the week
body: Nathan had Chris & Miguel down to a 19% win chance at Sun 8:22pm, mostly on the back of Christian McCaffrey, whose 66-yd TD catch swung the matchup 32% and whose 74-yd TD catch added another 23%. It wasn't enough. Bad JuJu won 131.1–115.8, and the series sits at 10–10.

That makes Nathan the league's unluckiest manager (3–7, scored like a 5.3-win team) and its most scored-upon, with 1305.2 points against. The replays are on the site if you want to watch it happen again.

sections.head: Around the league
body: Mack posted the week's top score, 176.7, and needed most of it: Michael put up 149.2 and lost, now the season's highest-scoring loser. The 176.7–149.2 game is the 5th highest-scoring in league history. Cam Skattebo's touchdown swung it 27% toward Michael, and Isaiah Likely's 66-yd TD catch swung it 17% back toward Mack.

Connor & Kunal beat Andrew & Nick 162.2–90.4, the blowout of the week by 71.8. They are averaging 151.3 a game; the season record is 141.8, set by Kevin in 2018. If it ended now, Got New Legs would rank first of 166 team-seasons in league history by dominance.
Mike beat Kevin 146.9–98.5. Dustin pulled the upset of the week, 128.5–89.0 over Trey, who left 26.8 points on his bench while losing by 39.5.

sections.head: The playoff picture
body: The top five are effectively settled. Connor & Kunal and Peyton have clinched their divisions, Mack has clinched a spot, and Mike (92% last week) and Chris & Miguel (90%) are now at 99% or better.

That leaves one seat for seven teams. Nathan leads that scrum at 26%, then Trey at 23% (down from 41%), Dustin at 17% (up from 8%), Michael at 12%, Andrew & Nick and Kevin at 10% each. John fell from 16% to 4% after scoring the week's lowest total.

sections.head: Game of the Week
body: Kevin vs Andrew & Nick: two 3–7 teams, and the biggest playoff swing on the board at 33%. Due For A Win is projected 108.2–99.4 and has a 60% chance, with Josh Allen projected for 23.4. Andrew & Nick lead the series 8–6.
Elsewhere, Peyton gets Trey at 84% to go 11–0, and Nathan, the bubble leader, is a slight favorite (58%) over 8–2 Mack.

groupme: Week 10 issue is up. Peyton is 10–0 and the power ratings still have him fifth, behind a 3–7 team. Chris & Miguel came back from 19% on Nathan despite two long McCaffrey TD catches, and Mack and Michael just played the 5th highest-scoring game in league history. Five playoff spots are basically gone. Seven teams want the sixth, and two of them play each other this week.
